Production Unity Rusher enemy sprite animation sheet. Reference defines exact identity and perspective; redraw distinct articulated actions of this same creature. Lean athletic quadruped with very long sharp spear/wedge-shaped head and tall swept-back layered rocky armor blade along spine; dark brown plates, pale gray sinewy load-bearing legs, amber eye slit at front.
